stages.name: Onboarding
stages.description: Complete your seller profile, sign the Form 6 appointment and secure your pre-sale finance facility.

gateConditions.description: Form 6 (Appointment of Agent) signed by seller and countersigned by platform
Pre-sale finance facility approved by ListReady
Seller confirms all onboarding information is correct

actionText.seller: Sign your Form 6 and complete your finance application to get started
actionText.agent: Awaiting seller onboarding — you will be matched once complete
actionText.platform_admin: Review Form 6 countersign and finance approval

stages.name: Agent Assignment
stages.description: The platform matches and assigns your auction specialist agent. Conjunction agreement signed and strategy discussion held.

gateConditions.description: Conjunction agreement signed by agent and platform
Agent introduction and auction strategy session completed
Seller approves the assigned auction agent and is ready to proceed

actionText.seller: Review your matched auction agent and confirm you're ready to proceed
actionText.agent: Sign your conjunction agreement and schedule your property introduction
actionText.platform_admin: Match auction specialist; confirm introduction complete

stages.name: Property Preparation
stages.description: Complete all pre-auction improvements — repairs, cleaning, styling, and professional photography.

gateConditions.description: All approved improvements completed and signed off by agent
Professional photography delivered and approved
Seller approves property is ready for marketing

actionText.seller: Approve quotes and coordinate access for tradespeople and photographers
actionText.agent: Coordinate all preparation works and confirm completion

stages.name: Appraisal & Reserve Strategy
stages.description: Your agent provides a formal appraisal with comparable sales data. Together you set the auction reserve price.

gateConditions.description: Formal appraisal report with comparable sales delivered
Reserve price reviewed and signed off by platform
Seller formally sets and approves the reserve price

actionText.seller: Review the appraisal report and set your reserve price
actionText.agent: Deliver formal appraisal with comparable sales and recommend a reserve
actionText.platform_admin: Review reserve setting against market data
actionText.default: Appraisal and reserve strategy in progress

stages.name: Auction Campaign
stages.description: Four-week marketing blitz — Domain, REA, social media, and open homes build competitive tension ahead of auction day.

gateConditions.description: Auction listing live on Domain and REA with auction date
All scheduled open homes completed and buyer interest reported
Seller confirms they are prepared for auction day

actionText.seller: Attend open homes if desired and prepare for auction day
actionText.agent: Drive the campaign — open homes, buyer follow-up, competitive tension
actionText.platform_admin: Monitor campaign performance and buyer registration

stages.name: Auction Day
stages.description: The auction is held. If sold under the hammer, contracts are exchanged on the day. If passed in, negotiate immediately.

gateConditions.description: Auction conducted — result recorded (sold, passed in, or withdrawn)
Auction result validated by platform and contract initiated
Seller confirms the auction outcome and authorises next steps

actionText.seller: Attend the auction and confirm your decision on the result
actionText.agent: Conduct the auction, negotiate if passed in, record outcome
actionText.platform_admin: Record auction result and initiate contract process

stages.name: Contracts & Exchange
stages.description: Execute the Sale Contract — either on auction day (unconditional) or post-auction negotiation.

gateConditions.description: Sale Contract prepared and sent to all parties
Sale Contract signed by buyer and seller via DocuSign
Seller confirms the executed contract

actionText.seller: Countersign the Sale Contract to complete the exchange
actionText.agent: Prepare and execute the Sale Contract with buyer
actionText.platform_admin: Validate contract execution and track deposit

stages.name: Settlement
stages.description: Final settlement — transfer of title, release of deposit, repayment of finance facility, and distribution of proceeds.

gateConditions.description: Settlement date confirmed with all parties and conveyancers
Settlement funds confirmed and reconciliation processed by platform
Seller confirms receipt of net proceeds

actionText.seller: Confirm settlement details with your conveyancer and await net proceeds
actionText.agent: Coordinate with all parties to confirm settlement date
actionText.platform_admin: Process settlement reconciliation and distribute proceeds
